request.state:
L01: The Friday review looks back at the week and no further.
L02: It runs for forty minutes and never longer.
L03: Anyone may attend and nobody must.
L04: The notes go out the same afternoon.
L05: The chair rotates each month.
L06: The review is held in the Larch room on the second floor.
L07: A remote link is open for anyone away.
L08: The link is in the calendar entry.
L09: Decisions taken there are written down or they did not happen.
L10: Nothing on the agenda carries over twice.
L11: An item that carries over twice becomes a ticket.

q1.instructions: Which line names the room where the Friday review is held?
